test: 2025 weekly 12Z hindcast (52 cycles), never fitted on
test_climatology: test-year forecasts replayed with a climatology from truth before 2025-01-01
statistic: 1 - prod(1 - p_hour)^step over the day's forecast hours (day 1: all of them; day 2: hours up to cover_end_utc), exactly as build_deploy.cal_day_stats builds it
target: at least one hourly below-CAT-I flag in the UTC day (>= 18 hourly obs)
method: isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators), blocks under 200 station-days pooled into the block below, one breakpoint per block, linear interpolation between
rule: A day's map ships only if, on the 2025 holdout, the published chance (a) has Brier skill > 0 against the per-airport monthly day climatology (dayscale.json climo_day, same rows) and (b) the group published >= 0.5, when it has n >= 50, verifies within 10 points of its mean. Each day-2 coverage hour is judged alone. The map tested (fitted on 2023-2024) is the map shipped; no refit on all three years.
rule_by_cycle_hour: Added after review, 2026-11-24: the same rule is scored on real cycles of the test year at each sampled cycle hour. A map is published from cycle hour h only when the nearest sampled hours at or below h and at or above h, among the hours that use that map, both pass (the 12Z holdout is the sample at hour 12), and only when the cycle is from the build's own UTC date.
rule_by_season: Added after review, 2026-11-24: rule (b) is also read off the Nov-Feb >= 0.5 group of every sample behind a published hour (50 airport-days or more). Where it misses by more than 10 points the map is not published for target days in November to February.
rule_by_area: Added after review, 2026-11-24: rule (b) is read off each area's own >= 0.5 group, on the test year and on all years, wherever that group has 50 airport-days. Where either misses by more than 10 points the day is not shown as calibrated for that area's fields; the number itself is unchanged. An area with neither sample at 50 is not judged.
